question: Which of the following agencies is responsible for the operation and maintenance of the Hazira- Vijaypur- Jagdishpur pipeline?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gas Authority of India Limited**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Gas Authority of India Limited (GAIL)** is responsible for the operation and maintenance of the Hazira-Vijaypur-Jagdishpur pipeline.
 
• GAIL is India's largest natural gas company and was established in 1984.
 
• The Hazira-Vijaypur-Jagdishpur pipeline, also known as the HVJ pipeline, is one of the longest and most significant natural gas pipelines in India.
 
• The pipeline facilitates the transportation of natural gas across several states, boosting industrial and domestic consumption.
 
• GAIL plays a crucial role in the distribution and marketing of natural gas in India, contributing to the country's energy security and economic growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• GAIL is also involved in the production and marketing of petrochemicals, liquid hydrocarbons, and LPG transmission.
 
• It has diversified into various fields like city gas distribution, exploration and production, and solar and wind power projects.
 
• GAIL has a significant presence in the international market, with investments and projects in various countries.
 
• The company is committed to sustainable development and has undertaken various initiatives to reduce its carbon footprint and promote green energy.
